tool_schemas.name: query_collection
tool_schemas.description: Searches a collection for the most similar points to the provided query_vector, applying an optional payload filter, optional score_threshold, and returning up to limit results after skipping offset; when with_payload/with_vector are true, the corresponding fields are included for each match. Returns either a list of scored point matches (synchronous) or, when wait is false, an enqueued request handle instead of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, limit/offset are out of range, or the query_vector is not a numeric array; raises NOT_FOUND when collection_name does not exist; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to query the collection; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED or RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to query.

query_vector.description: Vector used for similarity search against the collection.

filter.description: Optional payload filter object to constrain which points are eligible for matching.

limit.description: Maximum number of matched points to return.

offset.description: Number of matched points to skip before returning results.

with_payload.description: Whether to include matched points' payloads in the response.

with_vector.description: Whether to include matched points' vectors in the response.

score_threshold.description: Optional minimum similarity score threshold; results below this score are excluded.

request_source.description: Optional identifier describing where the request originated (e.g., app name or subsystem).

wait.description: If true, execute synchronously and return results; if false, enqueue and return a request handle.

tool_schemas.name: list_collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists collections, optionally filtered by status and sorted by sort/order, returning at most limit items; pagination is cursor-based, where the response includes a cursor to pass back to retrieve the next page (omit cursor to start from the beginning). Returns the page of collection summaries and the next cursor if more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit, cursor, status, sort, or order values; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot list collections; raises RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor to continue listing collections from a prior response.

order.description: Sort order for the returned collections.

tool_schemas.name: collection_info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves metadata for a single collection identified by collection_name and, when requested, includes configuration fields (include_config) and/or statistics fields (include_stats). Returns the collection description object with the selected sections populated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when collection_name is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the named collection does not exist; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to view the collection; raises RATE_LIMITED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to retrieve information for.

include_config.description: Whether to include collection configuration fields (e.g., vector_size, distance_metric, hnsw_config, optimizer_config).

include_stats.description: Whether to include collection statistics fields (e.g., points_count, vectors_count, segments_count, last_optimized_at).

tool_schemas.name: create_collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new collection with the provided configuration. Returns the created collection summary (including initial status=creating) when accepted. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameters (e.g., unsupported distance_metric, shard_count<1), and CONFLICT if a non-deleted collection with the same name already exists.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to create (must be unique among non-deleted collections).

vector_size.description: Dimensionality of vectors stored in this collection.

replication_factor.description: Number of replicas to maintain for the collection.

shard_count.description: Number of shards to split the collection into.

on_disk_payload.description: Whether payloads are stored on disk instead of in-memory.

optimizer_config.description: Optimizer configuration object controlling indexing/segment optimization (engine-specific fields).

tool_schemas.name: update_collection
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing collection's mutable configuration fields. Returns the updated collection metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is deleted; refuses with CONFLICT if the collection is deleting/deleted; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to update.

replication_factor.description: New replication factor for the collection.

shard_count.description: New shard count for the collection (if supported by the backend).

hnsw_config.description: Partial HNSW configuration update; omitted fields are unchanged.

optimizer_config.description: Partial optimizer configuration update; omitted fields are unchanged.

tool_schemas.name: delete_collection
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a collection by name. The service transitions the collection status to deleting and eventually to deleted. Returns a deletion acknowledgement. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is already deleted.

collection_name.description: Name of the collection to delete.

wait.description: If true, wait for deletion to reach status=deleted before returning; if false, return after status=deleting is set.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_points
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates points in a collection. Points are stored with status=active and replace any existing vector/payload for the same external_point_id (or point id if provided). Returns an acknowledgement including how many points were upserted. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is deleted; refuses with CONFLICT if the collection status is creating/deleting; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when any vector length does not match the collection's vector_size.

id.description: Optional internal point id (if omitted, the service will assign one).

external_point_id.description: Client-supplied id used for idempotent upserts within a collection.

vector.description: Vector to store for this point; length must equal the collection's vector_size.

payload.description: Optional payload metadata to attach to the point.

wait.description: If true, wait for the write to be durably applied before returning; if false, return after the write is accepted.

tool_schemas.name: delete_points
tool_schemas.description: Marks points as deleted within a collection (status transitions active -> deleted). Returns an acknowledgement including how many points were marked deleted. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is deleted; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if neither ids nor external_point_ids are provided.

wait.description: If true, wait for the delete to be applied before returning; if false, return after the delete is accepted.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as derived from the presented credentials, including current scopes and quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the credentials are missing or invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller.

metadata.name: Qdrant Vector Search Server
metadata.description: This backend models a Qdrant-like vector search service with named collections that contain vector points and optional payload metadata. The main workflows are: enumerate collections, fetch a collection's configuration/statistics, and execute a vector similarity query against a collection to return
